name: QuickThrow
teaser: Instantly throw grenades without equipping them (pre-0.12.12), with the option to perform a short throw on demand and a fallback key to use the vanilla throwing behavior when needed.
description_html:
This mod restores the deprecated “Fast Grenade Throw” mechanic from earlier Tarkov versions (<0.12.12), allowing you to instantly throw a grenade without having to equip it first.

  1. Fast throw grenade: Pressing the grenade key will throw the grenade instantly, skipping equip animations.
  2. Low throw override: Hold ‘Left Control’ to force a short throw with QuickThrow feature. It’s the wrong animation, but the grenade follows a trajectory as if you had thrown it with right-click

Restore Vanilla throw grenade ==> Hold Left Shift to equip it first.

F12 menu to configure 2 keybinds or disable the feature: :

  • Low throw ==> default : Left Alt
  • Force Vanilla throw grenade ==> default : Left Shift

‘QuickThrow’ folder into BepInEx/plugins.
